avis.titre: Who would've thought this spray would be so helpful
avis.texte: I swear I think this is one of the products that has been helping my perioral dermatitis. Mine isnt that bad, just some redness and sensitivity around my nose. But its the WORST and so annoying. I think im going to keep this as a holy grail product forever not only for the calming properties I feel like ive noticed but also how refreshing it is to apply. And honestly $5 extra for twice the amount of product as the smaller bottle? Lasts forever? Ill take it!
This product is great to use on sunburn! I use this every summer if I've had too much sun!
I love the Avene Thermal Spring Water! I have very sensitive skin that is prone to redness. This water calms calms and soothes my skin. I use it morning and night right before I apply moisturizer.

I have been doing a lot of Hot Sculpt and Saunas daily so my legs were really itchy to the point I was scratching and bleeding, leaving marks on my legs. Ever since starting to use this after showers , my skin is calmed and hydrated. Def a staple on my routine now.

Getting increasingly difficult to find but worth whether travel mini size or large 4 bathroom vanity size. Still the best hydration not much difference from Evian but slightly easier to purchase east coast USA

I picked this up as part of a set in the travel size and did not expect to get so hooked. The mist is incredibly fine and feels instantly refreshing — especially right after a shower. It gives that clean, calming feel without leaving residue or dripping. I wouldn't call it a strict must‑have, but it's definitely a nice‑to‑have that I now reach for constantly. I keep a mini in my purse and gym bag, and it's especially helpful after flights. My kids love it too, particularly in the summer as a quick refresher. Simple, soothing, and surprisingly addictive.

I love this spring water. After washing my face, I pat it dry then spray with this spring water before applying HA. It is a fine mist like spray, cool and refreshing. I like that it is not a pump spray.

Has a nice, fine mist that feels luxurious. Love using this to refresh during the day and in between steps in my skincare routine to stop my skin from drying. Good for sensitive skin. Good price for a fine mist.

avis.titre: I always have extra can at home
avis.texte: This is a wonderful product to use if you have rosacea, cooling to your skin

I originally thought this was all hype, but an ulta employee recommended it when I sent my boyfriend to grab some things for me when he asked them for help. I have sensitive skin and perioral dermatitis that flares a LOT, this stuff is a life saver for both!

avis.titre: Love the product hate the bottle
avis.texte: I have rosacea and this helped soothe and calm my red irritated skin. I use after cleansing as a toner and throughout the day when my skin feels tight, itchy or flushed. However, this was my second bottle and both bottles I had issues with the spray mechanism malfunctioning so as much as I love the product I will not repurchase. When it happened the first time I loved it so much I repurchased but after buying two bottles and both didn't work after a few sprays I will not repurchase. So disappointing because it really is a great product.

To the reviewer who said" spray a little of this before you blend out your foundation" Just know you changed my life! For the first time ever my skin actually looked soft and hydrated with makeup on! Total game changer! I couldn't believe my own eyes. I also can't belive how more people haven't caught on to this. This can completely take you from looking dry and cakey to looking more plump and fresh! Amazing for anyone who has dryness or texture and wears makeup. A little mist before blending out your foundation goes a long way. PLUS, your skin will feel so calm and soothed all day. It will literally be thanking you! I let my night time moisturizer dry and do a little mist as my last step at night now too. If people only knew what this stuff could do, it would stay sold out!

avis.titre: Soothing for irritated skin and scalp
avis.texte: I used a new shampoo that irritated my scalp and left scabs and dried blood. This spray helped heal my scalp and soothe the irritation. My office is extremely warm and dry and ive been using this on my face and scalp theoufh out the day to refresh and wllininate the dry and tight feeling on my skin.

I've only had this for a few days, but this works wonders!!! A spot on my elbow was itchy, and after a couple sprays of this and the itching stopped. I recently developed new food allergies, which have formed a rash on my mouth. I'm on day 3 of using this and I have to say it is almost healed. I definitely have to have backups of this on hand. I have highly sensitive/reactive skin and I have had no issues with this!

This product may sound like a scam becuse it's "just water in a can" but this genuinely is magic. I spray this EVERYWHERE on eczema, rashes, sunburn, post skin picking, and for when I need hydration. If I was stuck on a deserted island, I would bring this and be fine.

For those of you that don't wash your face in the am, the Thermal Spring water is the perfect step. Quick morning mist before applying my products works out perfectly for me. I've been using this for years and it has become a consistent part of my routine.

I spray this after I appy sunscreen in the am (my last step in my routine) . I just feel like it sets my skincare routine lol but i spray it multiple times a day because I love skincare. If i ever feel like my face feels dry, oily, or dealing with redness I spray it and Im feeling good again!

avis.titre: I Repurchased Another One. Necessary? No. Convenient? Yes!
avis.texte: Is canned water you can spray around necessary? No. Is it nice and convenient? Yes. I use this when I get out of the shower and my face has arrived and looks red. I spray this and then put my toner/ serum on. It helps the skincare with moisture, reduces my redness, and reduced stinging. I also use it every morning when I sit down to get ready for makeup. I have a retinol routine at night and sometimes I wake up with dry tight feeling skin. I spray this on my face for a wake up/ and re-moisturizing step, then put on my toner/ serums and eye gels. I understand that having water present in the mix of your skin care can help the skincare restore moisture to the skin. I am using heaters at night sometimes and my skin can get even more parched on those nights and any assistance with re-storing moisture in the morning helps. Another use I have found with this product is for my makeup sponges. My makeup area is not near the sink and I don't remember to get my sponge damp sometimes before makeup. Spray your sponge with this and get started on the makeup. I also like using it for the angled brushes that need to make dark eyeliner lines and spray the brush wet and then do eyeliner. It helps make the line really dark and sharp. It's a huge loss if it is gone but when you have it and realize it saves some steps and time, it is super helpful.

I thought this product was for refreshing your skin and giving your makeup a little freshness. If you spray this on your made up face, it will take your makeup off. It's just water. It doesn't calm irritated or sensitive skin. It's just water that you have to pat dry. It's really inconvenient to carry this can of water and a wash cloth to pat off the excess. I don't understand the hype around this product. It splatters the water everywhere and you're just left with a wet face. Putting water in a spray mist bottle would give you more controlled and hydrating results. I would never repurchase.

I love this. I recently got this from a dermatogolist recommended kit. I have been using it on my face & love. More recently I have been trying this on my legs. You need this if you need extra hydration.
for some reason this broke me out. as well as the lrp one . sucks bc I wanted to love.

avis.titre: Saves my skin from hard water!!
avis.texte: I live in an area with the hardest water that dries my skin out badly. For years, I've sprayed this water on my face, hands, and arms and then massage in my face and body lotion. I'm hydrated all dang day, with no dryness at all! It's liquid gold!

This spray is a game changer for me. It probably has magic in it because it works so well. I have incredibly sensitive skin that gets really reactive due to rosacea. I have light sensitivity and can often feel my face starting to react even in the middle of the day after being outside or under fluorescent lights. But a short mist with this water and my skin calms right down. I keep a travel size in my work bag and a big size at home.

So basically let me start that i have combination slightly sensitive and acne prone skin and saw people talking about chatGpt making theor skincare and they recommended me this and i went to target caise they also that is mini so i can give a try LET ME TELL YOU !!! i am in love woth this cause i have redness around my nose area and it super refresh !!!! avis.titre: #1 product in my book for Rosacea

Best addition to my dehydrated and dry skin. Helps to calm redness for rosacea. My skin feels refresh !

SAVED my from from perioral dermatitis!!! A godsend, will definitely be using this every day from here on out, its very refreshing… doesnt leave me dry OR oily. Gets rid of redness, itching, and burning.
Decided to try this out, and I am glad I did. It's refreshing, assists with redness, and moisturizing. I have rosacea, eczema, and sensitive skin. I also use avene face wash, and moisturizer.
The sprayer concentrates it in one section of your face and makes my face feel oily and greesie
Who knew that the only thing that will help my daughter's acne is thermal water. It's not 100% gone but its getting there after a few weeks of consistent use. It's amazing!
Who knew that the only thing that will help my daughter's acne is thermal water. It's not 100% gone but its getting there after a few weeks of consistent use. It's amazing!

I didn't really expect this to do anything for my skin, but I was desperate after developing some eczema on my face. The usual moisturizers weren't doing much so I gave this a go. After a few days my skin is practically back to normal and even feels softer than usual. It's definitely not just water.

This spray is my absolute holy grail. I have combination, sensitive, acne-prone skin and this calms my skin soooo well. I notice a visible change in my skin when I don't use this spray. For application, I usually spray this right after washing my face while my skin is damp and let it sit for a couple minutes before patting my skin dry. Kinda like a toner. This is a vital product in my everyday/night skincare routine and I will forever repurchase.

avis.titre: Truly a holy grail for skincare
avis.texte: I've used this for years for sunburns and my rosacea, but recently it saved me during an INTENSE drug reaction rash. When the itch became overwhelming, and my prescriptions weren't helping, I covered myself with this spray which gave me instant relief! I will never be without a can of this spray.

This is something I didn't know I needed. I'll definitely keep repurchasing. The mist feels amazing. Its 10x better than spraying your face with water from the sink. I use this in betweens steps in my skincare routine for extra hydration

Don't buy a toner, use this instead. It instantly calms angry skin, faster than anything Ive used. And, you can spray it on as much as you need, and its refreshing. I love spraying it on, addicted!!!! If you get facial procedures, its a must have staple. If you live in a dry climate and use hyaluronic acid, its a must have. Love love!!!
Love keeping this in my bag for hot summer days at the ball fields but also when my skin is feeling dry in the winter! It's an all seasons staple. Last longer than you'd think!

Refreshing! It's a super fine mist which feels lovely to the skin. I use it after my toner before my either day or night cream. It's also nice to mist over your face throughout the day. Highly recommend.

I have been using this for years and I love it. I use it after I was my face and tone, before applying hyaluronic acid. I feel like it really preps my skin and my skin doesn't feel as hydrated without this thermal spray
feels amazing. Fights against bad bacteria that may reside ln our skin. Use on your bikini line or after microblafing the face - a microbiologist

I can't not believe I buy WATER in a spray can but it does make a noticeable difference to the texture of my skin. I hydrate my skin before I lock in moisture and I'm skin is plump all day. I use to use tap water for the same thing, but after receiving this is a sample pack, I'll never go back.

This spray is wonderful for my skin. it gives light,balanced moisture. It is perfect for when I only feel like I need a light toner before sun protection. It seems to reduce inflammation, and pore/crease appearance. I love to set makeup with it. It leaves the skin looking like velvet. ♡ The nozzle is no good and spurts inconsistently. Considering the cost and reputation of the company, there's no excuse for this. Fix the nozzle. It's 2024,we have the technology.
I love using the thermal spring water for instant cooling and refreshing when I am overheated or suffering hot flashes. It's so great for my skin.

I love spraying this on my face or anywhere on my body post shower or for a refresh. I prefer to apply serums and moisturizer with my face still dewy from the shower so if I've waited too long then I use this spray. It's perfect for dry skin on the legs and arms too before applying moisturizer.

I have purchased the Avene Thermal Spring Water several times. I like to spray my face after gently patting off the excess water, spray my face and neck then apply my skincare products. The last set is locking it in with the Avene spray. During the hot summer days, I spray my arms, rub in a body lotion and then lock it in with the spray. My skin stays hydrated and has a glisten to it!
Given to me by my Sister who is a physician. I use it under moisturizer.
Check the ingredients. It is literally just water and aerosol to make it spray. Such a gimmick. Don't waste your money.
This is refreshing however, you should check the ingredients. It is literally just water. It is a complete gimmick.
Love this mist! So cooling and refreshing; my skin would get so tight right after showering, but this has been a skin saver while i apply the rest of my routine.
I have only used this a few times but so far, I really like it. It will come in handy in the summer.
So refreshing, I love this product so much I will never go without it.

avis.titre: Super product, also calming to skin.
avis.texte: Stellar calming solution, which also seems to remove deposits of heavy metals from tap water by washing them away. Also is a good prep for then applying bioactive compounds in skin care products. It is MUCH superior to other "spring water" sprays I have tried that were less costly.

avis.titre: Absolute holy grail product for me
avis.texte: I have very fair, extremely reactive, dry skin (natural redhead, post-menopausal) and will NEVER be without this stuff if I can help it. It erases any redness/irritation on my skin almost instantly. During a recent make-over/product discovery session my skin reacted badly to a very high end serum but having a small can of this in my bag saved me. I keep the biggest bottle I can purchase at home and the little one in my bag at all times. I don't know how or why it works and honestly don't care. Do not be fooled that its a moisturizer, it isn't. But it is definitely anti-inflammatory.
Brightened, freshy, healthy and cleaned. Try it, your skin will Thank you to you.

My daughter brought this back from Montreal and wow! Wish I had known about it sooner. I am post op ankle surgery with nerve damage in my toes that are burning pain. Very soothing therapy for migraine also. I am using it on my face several times a day in addition to my skin care serums and moisturizer. I live in Florida and ordered several cans to keep in the fridge. Amazing product.

I am a cancer survivor and pre-cancer I thought these spring waters in a can were a waste of money to be quite blunt. I had gotten a couple of samples and had just put them in my drawer and forgotten about them. After I was diagnosed and went through radiation and chemotherapy my skin was so dry and in some places actually burnt. I also was thrown into medically induced menopause and so was having raging hot flashes. I came across the small size of this in my drawer one day and I thought it couldn't hurt to just use it to help me cool my face down during hot flashes. This was the beginning of my obsession with this product. It not only is perfect for cooling yourself down during any kind of hot flash, it is especially cooling on the back of your neck during a hot day or when you've got a sunburn, it feels amazing especially on skin that is sensitive and tender. I had literal burns from my radiation on my back, my skin had crisped up like chicken skin when you cook it and cracked off so I knew I had to use something that was not only gentle but not full of harmful chemicals to make my burn feel worse. This felt amazing on it, even more so than the prescription ointments I was given to heal my skin. Now I am 3 years in remission, and I have cans of this everywhere. I literally mean everywhere. I keep one in a cup holder on my bicycle, I keep them in my gym bag obviously, there's one on my nightstand, my vanity, in my living room, in my shower, and I keep one tucked behind my co
On my second bottle. Use it for my sensitive skin but also use to to blow out my hair! If you want shiny, glowing hair, try this when blowing out your style. It's amazing.

It makes my skin look absolutely flawless! I have generally very sensitive/ oily skin with the occasional breakouts and is also dry and over-cracked lips. When I use the Avene Thermal Spring water spray, my skin clears up and pours nearly disappear. The texture softens and the redness I have goes away. My lips are also baby soft... I can't explain the magic behind it, just that it exists. The results are noticeable within days! I highly recommend this product.

I had to comment after reading the review that says it's just water and we're all getting scammed. This isn't your average tap water. I never would have tried it until I got a free can in a set. Even then, it went under my sink and was ignored until a particularly dry winter in Denver. I don't know how, but this water turned my skin around in a matter of days. It's now the first step of my skincare routine year round and my skin had never felt better. Bonus if you live in a dry climate like me-it dries completely in maybe 30 seconds, no waiting a few minutes and patting dry. And just for science, I tried filtered tap water in a fine mist bottle for a few weeks. It feels as refreshing, but it doesn't leave my skin as soft and hydrated. Tap water sprayed directly on just-cleansed skin leaves my face feeling tight and dry again within a few minutes. Avene sprayed on just-cleansed skin feels soft and hydrated for at least 30 minutes (the longest I've been distracted and forgotten to move into the next step).

I have sensitive skin and very mild rosacea. After using the water 2 nights in a row, within minutes after applying, red blotches appeared. After washing it off and applying a lotion with niacinamide it calmed down. So not as gentle as it claims.

I cannot do without this product! It is so refreshing and hydrating on the face and neck!! Lasts a pretty long time also. When I feel too warm on my face and neck I give a good spray and the redness and warm feeling goes away! I highly recommend this product!

This is the best product after cleaning your face with using the clear product from Avene you spray this on your face and let it sit then pad your Face is refreshed and clean the add your foundation your skin is so amazing. Feels so good

I have oily skin and live in a tropical climate so I don't necessarily want to use a moisturizing cream in the daytime. This works very well to hydrate my skin without looking oily and does not clog my pores.
I've been using Avene Thermal Spring Water for several years now and I absolutely love it! I spray it on my face every time I walk by it during the day, and certainly before I head to bed.
After using the Micellar water I spray my face with this spring water/ My face feels smooth, hydrated and refreshed and without any sticky residue.

avis.titre: Must try if you have any skin conditions such as Eczema!
avis.texte: I stumbled on the Thermal Spring water through a relative who also has dry, itchy, and sensitive skin. Ever since I've been applying this product to my face, my skin has been hydrated to the highest extent. Once you try this product, you will love Avene forever!

This has helped calm an eczema patch or 2 on my arms. I will have significant itchiness that in the oar had only been cooked by chills compress. This has helped to calm the itching much quicker than a cold compress!

Never will you ever catch me without this product again. This product has soothed my face when it is the most inflamed. Tretinoin can have a way of making my skin a bit dry. I use this product by itself throughout the day or on top of the Cicalfate+ Restorative Protective Cream in the evening. It has also helped me keep my hands off my face when I feel tempted to search for bumps. Whenever I feel the urge, a quick spritz of this has been the ultimate remedy to manage something I've struggled with for so long.

I use this spray on my face, and it is a great base for my hyaluronic acid. I also use this on my hair. I have 3B/3C hair, so I don't wash it daily and in between washes, I use this to refresh my waves and curls. Thin mist awaken them without oversaturating them. I have probably purchased at least 20 cans of this spray within the last year.
What not to love it: easy use anywhere and anytime; fantastic, refreshing mist

I love this stuff. It's made my skin so soft and balanced. I use it morning and night on a clean face. Often at night it is all I use. And sometimes I spritz my face after applying my tinted moisturizer, just because it feels so good! I gave a small bottle to my 33yr old daughter to try for her sensitive, hormonal skin and she raved about it. I intend to keep using this beautiful, magical spring water! Highly recommend.
It's refreshing and feels like it really is calming to my skin.
Love this mist. It calms my skin after washing my face. No smell at all. After Misting I put on a light layer of oil and cream.

I like to spray this on as soon as I get out of the shower. I let it soak in, and then I apply my Avene products. It's so calming and refreshing to my skin. My skin has never felt better since using Avene products.
i've been using this product for two years since i received the minis in a gift set, i love this brand and product
I moved to MT from MI this year and this product has been an essential part of adapting to this extremely dry climate!

I love this fresh and cool spray on my face. I use it throughout the day. Absolutely amazing!

A great product for moisture, calming, healing. I use this as a toner, as the first layer before my other treatment products, and my husband uses it after shaving, because it is calming and heals the irritation left by the razor blade.

I have very dry , sensitive skin. Prone to reddness and feeling warm and itchy. This feels so nice and calming to spray on my face. My daughter uses it on my grandson's face ( hevis 5 years old) when he has an eczema flate up. It soothes his skin and helps keep him from rubbing the area.

avis.titre: It's the perfect booster for dry skin

It refreshes my skin and hydrates it before I put my face lotion on.
My daughter and I LOVE using these. I just recently bought us the 'on the go' smaller size set and we love that too.

Avene thermal spring water is like no other! As a dermatology nurse, I have been using this product on my patients and on myself for MANY years and it truly is amazing…..soothing, decreases redness and inflammation! Thank you, Avene!!!
I love it..! This is my go to when I want to refresh my face throughout the day. The packaging is easy to use and its application as well. Highly recommended..!
My dermatologist used this on me in the office and I had to order my own. So great!
It hydrates my skin very well, it feels so good on fresh in my skin

This is an amazing water. It literally helps eczema go away. It totally calms the skin. I spray it on my face and neck every day after washing and then lock in the moisture with cream. World favorite. I think in New York you need something to soothing your skin after many drastic changes on relayed and humidity during the day. This thermal water is the best option to do so. It calms your skin before make up and after any skin care routine.
Refreshing and hydrating! A must have! Spray this on, add an HA product of your choice and see the glow- you won't be disappointed!
So refreshing and the mist is fine which makes absorption quick.

I discovered this product when I got it in one of my FunFitFab boxes and loved it from the very first spray. I have red, painfull, inflamed and warm to touch cheeks. Everything hurts it. Its not always beat red but it gets very bad after washing or stuff like that. Even if the product is good. I sprayed this bad boy on my face and BOOM instantly felt relief. The thermal spring water is SOoooooo refreshing! Great on hot days to just give yourself a nice"pick me up"-- I use it all times of the year, it just gives you a nice feeling of freshness & invigorates you....

avis.titre: I wish that I could drink it!

I always combine it with the Coola facial mist sunscreen.
Love a spritz of this water before my moisturizer. I have hard water so it's a treat.

i have sensitive, combination skin and my face tends to get hot and flushed when im stressed or busy. the avene thermal spring water comes out in a fine, cool mist and it is truly delightful. i bought this on a whim bcus it was on sale and i wanted to feel like an upperclass lady, but this prodcut suprised me by how much i like it. imagine standing near a waterfall and feeling the gentle spray of the falls carressing your face. thats how it feels. it definitely soothes my red flushed irritated face when i need it, but i cant speak to any long lasting improvements (yet). so grateful i had this product during the brutal heat this summer. if you have a hot tomato face like me, try this product

I use this directly after I cleanse my skin AND after I finish my skincare routine. My face has never looked better. Pro tip: use it to refresh your makeup after a long day or before you blend your foundation. Thank me later.
